global_attributes.title: Global 1-month SPEI, z-values, 0.5 degree
global_attributes.summary: Global dataset of the Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) at the 1-month time scale. Using CRU TS 4.09 precipitation and potential evapotranspiration data
global_attributes.keywords: drought, climatology, SPEI, Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index
global_attributes.institution: Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas, CSIC
global_attributes.software: Created in R using the SPEI package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SPEI/;https://github.com/sbegueria/SPEI)
global_attributes.reference: Beguería S., Vicente-Serrano S., Reig F., Latorre B. (2014) Standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index (SPEI) revisited: Parameter fitting, evapotranspiration models, tools, datasets and drought monitoring. International Journal of Climatology 34, 3001-3023.
global_attributes.reference2: Vicente-Serrano S.M., Beguería S., López-Moreno J.I. (2010) A Multiscalar Drought Index Sensitive to Global Warming: The Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index. Journal of Climate 23, 1696–1718.
global_attributes.reference3: Beguería S., Vicente-Serrano S., Angulo-Martínez M. (2010) A multi-scalar global drought data set: the SPEIbase. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society 91(10), 1351–1356.

annual_aggregation.rule: calendar-year arithmetic mean of monthly values
